test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that contains a grammatical error in the underlined portion. **

There are no tables at the classroom.

options.text: There are no tables at the __classroom__.
__There are__ no tables at the classroom.
There are __no tables__ at the classroom.
There are no tables __at the__ classroom.

solution:
The correct answer is "**There are no tables __at the__**** classroom**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **error** lies in the **last part** of this sentence. The word "**at**" is erroneous.
 
• This is an **error of prepositions**. The placement of "**at**" preposition is** inaccurate.**
 
• Let's understand the implication of the incorrect preposition:
 
• **At**: **in the direction of** or t
